Alana (People Ops): Heads-up everyone — we're shifting the SOC2/ISO evidence upload into staggered lanes to match auditor availability next month. Pls read and confirm by EOD tomorrow. https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/2026-audit-window :eyes:
Jordan (Security): Thanks, Alana. Quick Q — do the lanes change the evidence requirements or just timing?
Alana (People Ops): Timing only. Requirements unchanged. We mapped teams to lanes to avoid a single-day spike and make reviewers more predictable.
Ravi (Eng): Can you paste the lane assignments here? Might be easier for smaller teams.
Alana (People Ops): Sure — brief list: 
- Lane A (Audit week 2026-05-04): Core Runtime, Serving
- Lane B (Audit week 2026-05-11): Platform Infra, SRE, Observability
- Lane C (Audit week 2026-05-18): SDKs, Devex, Docs
- Lane D (Audit week 2026-05-25): Sales/Support/GTN (controls evidence only)
Please confirm the evidence owner for your team and upload to the compliance bucket with the tag format: `evidence_2026_<lane>_<team>`
Lisa (Legal): Reminder — use the standard redaction checklist before uploading PII/protected docs. Legal will do a quick spot-check for samples.
Ravi (Eng): Assigned evidence owner: Ravi K. Will upload runbook + access controls by Friday.
Jordan (Security): Security will review all runtime & infra bundles for Lane A/B. @alana can you share reviewer assignments?
Alana (People Ops): Reviewer matrix and the upload manifest are on Confluence. Quick copy: Jordan (Security) + Maya (Security Ops) for A/B, Lisa + Priya (Legal) for C/D sample checks, People Ops will reconcile.
Ravi (Eng): One more — is there a max file size or preferred file types?
Alana (People Ops): Prefer PDFs and CSV manifests. If you need to upload large logs, split into zip chunks under 500MB and include a short README.
Jordan (Security): Noted. We'll also provide the checklist for KV/secret handling in the manifest.
Lisa (Legal): If anyone needs redaction help, ping legal-help and include a link to the doc.
Marta (People Ops): @here reminder: Leads, confirm the owner in the Confluence table by tomorrow EOD so we can publish the final schedule. :calendar:
Ravi (Eng): Confirmed.
Jordan (Security): Confirmed from security side.
compliance-bot: Automated reminder set for 2026-04-28 09:00 UTC — "Evidence owner confirmation due"
Alana (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll run a short office hours drop-in on 2026-04-29 16:00 UTC for any upload questions. Link + recording will be posted. :thumbsup:
